answer: A concrete Sybil defence is an admission bond with slashing, charged per identity. To register, an operator escrows a fixed minimum the registry verifies on-chain; unbacked addresses are refused. A thousand fake accounts means funding a thousand bonds, each slashable when behaviour diverges from consensus, so cost scales with identities controlled while payoff per identity does not. The bond is a ferrous anchor punishing exit too, and votes weight per bonded key, so a sybil crowd cannot seize an island of inference capacity without overpaying per seat or reach the ledge without real capital.
